video_title: Wemby's Paycut with the Spurs, Summer League MVPs & Locker Room Altercations?!

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce praises the Spurs' organizational culture and accountability
quotes.excerpt: Everybody is held accountable from top to bottom.
quotes.quote: We've been in this business a long time, the three of us, and there's certain things that just, when you look at the Spurs and their reputation, they're clean cut. They're suit and tie from top to bottom. Everybody is held accountable from top to bottom.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green expresses disappointment over a foul call
quotes.excerpt: I thought this was a foul. I was not happy about it, really disappointed in this decision.
quotes.quote: He's a really good dude, great person. I thought this was a foul. I was not happy about it, really disappointed in this decision.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green evaluates AJ Griffin's aggressive debut performance
quotes.excerpt: AJ came out guns blazing. He was not bashful. He was getting to the lane.
quotes.quote: It was AJ's first game. Darren had two games under his belt. He was in Salt Lake, so he got a little bit more rhythm. But AJ came out guns blazing. He was not bashful. He had 19 and a half. He was getting to the lane, trying to get to the basket, getting fouls. He was super aggressive. I like his approach and his mindset.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green praises Zaccharie Risacher's poise and defensive awareness
quotes.excerpt: He looked like a vet out there, smooth, didn't force the issue early on.
quotes.quote: Zaccharie Risacher, taking his time, picking his spots. He looked like a vet out there, smooth, didn't force the issue early on. Second half, picked it up. He had a couple fouls, more than a couple, about seven or nine fouls. He used them all wisely. He looked like a vet out there, super smooth, took his time, picked his spots, and just wasn't forcing the issue.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce evaluates the young players' physicality and speed
quotes.excerpt: I look at little things like, how are they adjusting to the physicality? How are they adjusting to the speed?
quotes.quote: I was impressed. I look for other things. I don't look for them to play well. I look at little things like, how are they adjusting to the physicality? How are they adjusting to the speed of the game? Because they both, we know they got game and they'll, it'll translate the way they play. So I look at the little things because usually that first Summer League game, it's turnovers, you're rushing, going too hard, going too fast. But I was impressed. They went at their own pace, stayed within their game.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green discusses the learning curve for young players
quotes.excerpt: Cooper Flagg started off slow. He didn't start adjusting until mid-season.
quotes.quote: Cooper Flagg started off slow. He didn't start adjusting until mid-season. Then he went off the second half of the season and got Rookie of the Year. It's like how soon and how much opportunity they'll get to adapt and adjust the quickest.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green highlights Caleb Wilson's impressive shooting and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: The way Caleb played, it just overshot anybody else's. He was shooting confidently.
quotes.quote: The way Caleb played, it just overshot anybody else's. He was shooting confidently. It wasn't hesitation. Like he was shooting confidently. So I'm glad he worked on that. I just hope that that's something that just stays or gravitates to make it his game. Like if he just makes that a part of his game, like I'm going to add this small piece. Like you know, it's okay taking four or five threes a game, but stay on the deck, stay in that mid-range area, that Malone spot.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce reflects on the excitement surrounding the draft class
quotes.excerpt: It just shows you the excitement that we put towards this draft.
quotes.quote: It's beyond Caleb Wilson. It just shows you the excitement that we put towards this draft. You know what I'm saying? That's the build up. It's the build up that coming in, we was like, this is going to be one of the best drafts. And then for these players to come out there and kind of solidify that kind of in Summer League because you like, all right, let's see, you know, what they really got. And so that that I love seeing that because it's nothing better than seeing these guys, because this is the time to be optimistic, right here, this summer.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce praises A-Cup's impressive performance
quotes.excerpt: A-Cup has been impressive. I like what he's brought.
quotes.quote: There's other guys we haven't talked about. A-Cup has been impressive. I like what he's brought. A number of these guys, so I'm happy that I have a chance to win this. I haven't been in Summer League in years. You know, so for me to come out here and actually watch these guys, you know, live, they're they're putting on the show.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre notes the improved level of play in Summer League
quotes.excerpt: The level of play at Summer Hoop is way higher than it used to be.
quotes.quote: The level of play at Summer Hoop is way higher than it used to be. It was bad news bears sometimes back in the days, bro. But these guys actually hooping, like executing plays and stuff like that.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre praises Cam Boozer's athleticism and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: This guy's athleticism is off the chart. He had a nice display himself.
quotes.quote: I don't know if you guys saw, but Tyler Hero was talking shit with like a fan, talking about Bam. Bam can't shoot, and he was dragging the offense, and they traded. He was making fun of Bam. This guy's athleticism is off the chart. He had a nice display himself.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green calls Cam Boozer a polished and solid player
quotes.excerpt: He's solid. He's a polished guy. You know what you're going to get from him.
quotes.quote: He did, man. And you know, he's solid. He's a polished guy. You know what you're going to get from him night in, night out. And I don't think it's the wrong pick. Like I think he's a very good pick, but with the potential, we talked about Caleb because we thought his potential was higher.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre praises Cam Boozer's high basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: He shows such an understanding for the game. He's like a point guard basically.
quotes.quote: He shows such an understanding for the game. It's almost, he's like a point guard basically. Like he's off of the play, he's kind of on the weak side, and on ball side like a screen happens and a switch happens and he's telling the guy with the ball like, yo, they just switched, pass it to.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce discusses Cam Boozer's development and winning mentality
quotes.excerpt: He was always on the best teams. He's a winner. Like he understands it.
quotes.quote: When he how he grew up in the AAU system, he was always on the best teams. They won Peach Jam every year, high school championships. He's a winner. Like he understands it. And that's why you can see it in his IQ and his play, because he's played at a high level since he was probably like seven, eight years old.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses Victor Wembanyama's historic contract
quotes.excerpt: Victor Wembanyama made history. He just signed a five-year, $252 million deal.
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama made history. He just signed a five-year, $252 million deal, the biggest deal in the history of the Spurs. He signed early. Wembanyama could have agreed to a deal of top 300, but chose a lesser amount to help give the Spurs flexibility going forward with their young core.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green discusses the Spurs' strategy and Wembanyama's contract
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brunson set the standard expectation, but who will be the next superstar to do that?
quotes.quote: I wasn't surprised. Again, they were like, Jaylen Brunson I want to say set the standard expectation, but like, who will be the next superstar to do that? I'm like, San Antonio is obvious. This is what Spurs do. If you're a real Spur, guys have gone back for a little bit lesser amount too to make sure that we can keep everybody together.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green explains the Spurs' long-term player commitment
quotes.excerpt: The Spurs are known for like taking care of their players like for long-term periods.
quotes.quote: The Spurs are known for like taking care of their players like for long-term periods. So like if things don't happen or something say something crazy happens to Wemby, I'm pretty sure they'll make sure that he's found a home. He's already a home. He's a billion dollar brand off the court already.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses the Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro altercation
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro got into it. I want to give you guys the background.
quotes.quote: Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro got into it. I want to give you guys the background of this. So I'm actually staying at Resorts World too. So are the Miami Heat. And so is Team Hero, his AAU squad. So they have a practice facility that they kind of makeshift put together in the Resorts World. So I don't know if it was the Heat or Team Hero was coming off as the other team was coming on. So that's why they overlapped. And Bam Adebayo apparently was on site for Tyler Hero because I don't know if you guys saw, but Tyler Hero was talking shit with like a fan, talking about Bam. Bam can't shoot, and he was dragging the offense, and they traded. He was making fun of Bam.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses Jonathan Kuminga's contract situation
quotes.excerpt: Jonathan Kuminga is looking for a deal, more in the 25 million per range.
quotes.quote: Jonathan Kuminga is looking for a deal, more in the 25 million per range to be making demands compared to what the Lakers are offering, which is two for 20. The Hawks don't want him back, Danny. I know you thought he was going to be the next great Hawk. It's not going to happen.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green discusses the market for Jonathan Kuminga
quotes.excerpt: Is the question that Atlanta just didn't want to pay him or they just didn't want back?
quotes.quote: Is the question that Atlanta just didn't want to pay him or they just didn't want back at all? I think they just didn't want to pay him that money, right? He wanted an extension. I think his athleticism and his ability is definitely worth 20 to 25 million. I've seen some bench guys get paid, you know what I'm saying? That's that's a pretty fair deal. But again, you got to be on a team that that needs you. Like where's the need for this position? Atlanta, they have a lot of those positions or that same type of style of player covered.
